name: Leporano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Leporano (a hare on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Leporano, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Leporano arms — hare on blue, crowned, within branches
